source_kind: New evaluation-only synthetic English technical documentation, version 2.7
boundaries: The original questions, full translations, scripted followups, source texts and independent oracle must not change after inference results are observed.
Gold is for post-delivery evaluation only and must not enter selector or answering-model prompts.
All source retrieval uses one exact whole-project binding; workspace control semantics are not an actual MCP module-isolation test.
Fixed translations test cross-language retrieval with correct supplied translations, not autonomous translation quality.
Scripted second lookups test a controlled history replay, not autonomous missing-fact assessment.
Visible-context token counts are not provider usage. Provider usage is unavailable in this environment unless separately obtained from an authorized provider interface.
This small synthetic development-independent input set does not establish broad natural-document generalization or repair the unavailable historical Q02.
